annotations.text:
great_cto — direction ①: light monospace blueprint

The landing moves to a light ground; the board keeps its dark.
Consistency is sameness of RULES, not of background — six of
eight rules are shared.

Forced by measurement: #00d97e is 1.79:1 on light. One accent
cannot serve both grounds at text weight.

This spec is set in the direction it describes.
